card.name: Inside rare long word spellings
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of rare or foreign long words, such as drug names, plant and animal names, and pronunciation guides. It fires on bits like f, ip, if, is and ab before the word ends.

modes.label: Drug names
modes.description: A short piece in the middle of a drug name.

modes.label: Pronunciation respellings
modes.description: A letter inside a phonetic respelling in parentheses after a headword.

modes.label: Species and plant names
modes.description: A short piece inside a Latin or tropical plant name.

card.plain: It marks the middle of an uncommon long word, like a drug or species name, where the word is not yet finished.
